name: Media matrix rain
doc: Renders the input image or video as cascading Matrix-style Katakana and hex glyph columns driven by luma and edge contours, accelerating on beats with RGB glitch bursts on onsets.

luma.doc: media brightness mask (e.g. core-media.luma) controlling glyph density and luminance

edges.doc: media edge gradient (e.g. core-media.edges) highlighting contours in bright code

palette.doc: phosphor color ramp blended with the source media colors

speed.doc: rain fall speed multiplier synced to tempo

color_mix.doc: 0 = pure palette phosphor, 1 = source media colors

edge_boost.doc: bright glyph lock-on along media edges

glitch.doc: onset glyph scramble and horizontal RGB tear

glow.doc: overall glyph emission and head flare
